question_text: A 48-year-old Caucasian woman presents to her physician for an initial visit. She has no chronic diseases. The past medical history is significant for myomectomy performed 10 years ago for a large uterine fibroid. She had 2 uncomplicated pregnancies and 2 spontaneous vaginal deliveries. Currently, she only takes oral contraceptives. She is a former smoker with a 3-pack-year history. Her last Pap test performed 2 years ago was negative. She had a normal blood glucose measurement 3 years ago. The family history is remarkable for systolic hypertension in her mother and older brother. Her physical examination is unremarkable. Which of the following preventative tests is indicated for this patient at this time?
